rationale: Both defects from run 1 have been resolved and verified. D-01 (ISS-028, admin sidebar hardcoded app name) was fixed and Playwright-confirmed: sidebar now reads app_name from tenant config. D-02 (ISS-029, dept admin login redirect loop) was fixed and Playwright-confirmed: dept admin reaches /admin/dashboard; direct navigation to /admin/settings/branding is correctly redirected to /admin/dashboard (RBAC active). All in-scope acceptance criteria are now satisfied.
